voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`). captionY (px or "high") lifts the caption above low action.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Astika sub-parva, adhyaya 43 (the naming at 1.44): one evening the sage sleeps with his head in his wife's lap as the sun goes down; she weighs the choice: if he misses the evening rite, his dharma is lost; if she wakes him, he will be angry; she decides that dharma matters more and wakes him gently: the sun is setting, it is time for the evening worship. He wakes, his lips trembling with anger: she has insulted him; the sun has no power to set while he sleeps; he will leave her. She says she woke him for his dharma, not to insult him, and asks about the purpose for which her brother gave her (a son). He answers 'asti' (it is there): she carries a child who will be like fire, a great sage. He leaves. Because his father said 'asti', the boy is named Astika (1.44).
structure: From episode 21: COLD OPEN (≤ 8 words, ≤ 3 s; opening chosen by content (not a fixed rotation): a statement card by content (the stake, no pronoun without a noun): the sunset shaft on the sleeper, the card in the dark upper wall) → title (hook post) → STORY from ≈ 4.5 s with the UNVOICED recap band over its first shot → turn at 40–60 % after one ≈ 0.9 s rest → the cliffhanger image + line → a ≤ 1.2 s NEXT › band over the cliffhanger image that dissolves into frame 1. Gate: tools/gate.mjs (run by tools/render.mjs).

lines.speaker: jaratkaru
lines.text: "The sun would not dare to set while I slept. I am leaving."

lines.speaker: nagini
